reviews.text:
Very nice angel oracle app that just needs a little love.. To those using this, make use of the shuffle button before a reading for more accuracy. This is a beautiful app, and the 7 day trial allows one to use it before buying. The images are beautiful, and once I learned about the shuffle button the readings got much more accurate. This app has a great foundation, yet it really needs more from the developers to shine. 

For the developer: The number of characters you can enter as titles when you save your spread is too short to enter the entire question most of the time. Right now, there is also no guidance about the presence of the shuffle button in the directions at all. The instructions appear to refer to a physical card deck, and not the app. There is actually very little written in the guides period about the different spreads or how to best make use of the app. I would really like to see more spreads if possible, and an integrated journaling feature to allow jotting down our impressions when viewing or reviewing a reading. I really love where this and the other oracle apps are going, and thank you to the developer for bringing it out. 

I also own the Faery woods oracle by the same developer, and that feels much more fleshed out. Please get rid of all the advertisements for other apps, or make it opt in, as it can be really distracting.
